newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon issues CDs worth 31 billion pounds.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon issues CDs worth 31 billion pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon said on Wednesday it issued certificates of deposit dated July 18 to commercial banks worth 31 billion Lebanese pounds ($20.1 million).
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 31 billion pounds at 12.25 percent annual interest. It said there was no demand for 45-day CDs.
Last week the bank sold 60-day certificates worth 50 billion pounds at 12.25 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth four billion pounds at 11.5 percent.
The bank usually issues CDs on Thursday but this week they were announced one day early due to an official holiday on Thursday.
